name: The Scrap Sweeper
changesActuallyVisible: Clearly narrow lanky build and elongated limb silhouette.
Long asymmetrical dun/rust garment panels replace blouse/trouser emphasis; narrow trousers remain.
Same recognizable face, coarse curls, two short organic cheek filaments and listening gesture.
Magnetic collecting pole and bundled scrap sled retained.
caveats: Long panel extends below calf to near ankle, exceeding requested calf length but strengthening distinctive silhouette.
Head remains slightly tilted; height is an assigned design specification, with approximate visual calibration rather than a measurement.
Use front boot sole as ground, not magnetic collector or scattered scrap lower in the image.
Cheek filament roots retain source's somewhat ring-like bases, but no added mechanical fittings.

calibration.coordinateSystem: normalized image Y from top; anatomical crown excludes hair, ground is footwear sole contact
